text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls).

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key patterns observed:

Entry:
- Personal carry items (backpacks, jackets, keys, wallets, phones, headphones, scarves, shoes, water bottles, laptops, chargers, notebooks, pens, lunchboxes) are typically at the entry when residents are home.
- When residents leave for work (approx 08:00), these items disappear from the house (carried out).
- When residents return (approx 17:30-17:42), these items reappear at the entry spots.
- At 00:00, some items (phones, chargers) move to bedrooms (nightstand/desk) for the night.

Kitchen:
- Shared cooking items (cutting board, knife, spatula, pan) and dishes (bowls, mugs, glasses, plates, serving dishes) move to active use spots (sink, counter, table) in the evening (20:00) for meal prep/cleanup.
- By 00:00, these items are returned to storage (cupboards, drawers, dish rack).
- Water bottles move to the dish rack at 00:00, then to the entry when residents leave/return.
- At 20:00, knife, pan, and spatula are on the counter.

Living:
- No significant changes. Felix’s knitting bag remains on the couch.
- Aisha’s phone was seen on the coffee table at 00:00, then carried out at 08:00.

Bathroom:
- Personal items (razors, skincare, towels) remain on shelves/racks.
- Felix’s razor moved from medicine cabinet to sink at 08:00.

Bedroom:
- Laptops, tablets, books remain on desk/nightstand.
- Aisha’s glasses moved from nightstand to dresser at 00:00, back to nightstand at 08:00.
- Felix’s charger moved from entry to desk at 00:00, then carried out at 12:00 (likely with laptop).

Balcony:
- Gardening tools remain on floor/table. Gloves moved from floor to table at 08:00.

Office:
- Empty.

General Notes:
- "Not seen before" items at 00:00 (phones) were likely in pockets/bags during the 18:00 walkthrough.
- Residents carry their daily essentials (work items, personal care) out of the house in the morning and bring them back in the evening.
- Kitchen items follow a clear cycle: storage -> active use (evening) -> storage (night).
- Weekend pattern: Residents stay home. At 12:00, phones move to entry (errands), then return to living/bedroom areas by 16:00-20:00. Aisha’s running shoes move to entry floor at 19:44, suggesting evening run prep.
